description_expanded: Home Highlights:- Distance to Private Beach Access: Directly Across 30A- 1 Mile to Seaside- Community pool- 2 Parking Spaces- Gas Grill- 4 Adult bikes- Outdoor Balcony Seating for 6- Incredible Gulf Views- 1 Level on 3rd floor- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. DETAILS: Sleeping 12 in Seagrove Beach, 30A Unit 302 is a luxury condo with 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. Spend whirlwind days unwinding on sugar-sand beaches, shopping at the local boutiques, exploring Deer Lake State Park, and cruising the Timpoochee Trail in this classic beach town. Guests will fall in love with the captivating Gulf views and beachside community pool.The mesmerizing blue of the Gulf provides a stunning backdrop as guests enter this bright condo. The open floor plan offers plenty of room for friends and family to gather. Prepare a fresh seafood dinner in the well-equipped kitchen with high-end appliances, gleaming countertops, and a waterfall island that seats 4. The dining table is set in a cozy nook and has plenty of seating with an L-shaped bench and 5 chairs. A spacious sectional and comfortable armchairs surround the TV in the living area. Step onto the generous balcony with a gas grill, 4-person table, and soft seating to enjoy the coastal breeze and view. The primary bedroom has a king bed, a private bathroom, and direct access to the balcony. There are 2 guest bedrooms—1 has a king bed and the other 2 queen beds—along with a bunk room with 2 XL twin-over-twin bunk beds.Private beach access, dazzling views, and a Gulf-front community pool make 30A Unit 302 the ultimate setting for a delightful Seagrove Beach vacation. Easily explore the area with parking for 2 vehicles and 4 complimentary adult bikes. Beach access can be found directly across the street. Book this spectacular condo today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR: -Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Two XL Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only
